web_fixture.title: V1 signing retirement - Emberton Identity
web_fixture.snippet: The v1 signing notice goes out 165 days before v1 requests stop being accepted.
web_fixture.content:
# V1 signing retirement

Emberton Identity, notice published 2026-03-11.

V1 request signing stops answering on 2026-08-23. The notice goes out 165 days
before that date, so integrators have two quarters to move to the v2 scheme.
Calls signed with v1 after the stop date are refused with EM-907; calls signed
with v2 are unaffected and need no header changes.

turns.prompt: Emberton's v1 signing scheme is on its way out and our compliance review needs the notice period. How many days before the scheme stops answering does Emberton publish the notice? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
